name: ssdeep
description: Fuzzy hashing tool for comparing files based on similarity rather than exact matches

ssdeep.description: Generate and compare context triggered piecewise hashes (fuzzy hashes) to find similar files
ssdeep.usage:
ssdeep file.txt
ssdeep -r /path
ssdeep -m hashfile.txt -d /suspect
ssdeep -b -r /samples > baseline.txt
ssdeep -x hashfile.txt file.exe
